title: [VIC, NSW, QLD] 26¢ Per Litre off 7-Eleven Fuel in November after You Completed 10 Toll Trips between 1 & 31 October @ Linkt
body:
Deal: [VIC, NSW, QLD] 26¢ Per Litre off 7-Eleven Fuel in November after You Completed 10 Toll Trips between 1 & 31 October @ Linkt

[Lizard Spock] Am I going crazy or did it say "in August" a moment ago?
[Bellpop] Haha how’re the hoops to jump through to get this
[ciab] More like the tolls you’ve got to drive through
[cooperdog] Never heard about the August deal… That sounded much better…
And since you get 6c anyway that's 20c extra, or $10 on a 50L fillup, not worth running up extra tolls to qualify for.
[kevorulez] Most definitely do no deliberately run tolls just to get this "reward"!
Tiny bit of reward (condolence) for daily toll runners though :|
[jimojr] 20 cents per litre fuel discount at BP when paying with an eligible NAB card . I think it must be a targeted offer that isn’t showing in my NAB Goodies.
[Yabadabadoo] looks fake, AI generated. Very unlikely for any credit to be instantly applied given by the time it knows you're paying with a NAB card the amount is already finalised.
[mmrazz] 100% fake. Image contains a SynthID watermark that confirms it was generated with OpenAI. Also the URL at the bottom doesn't exist.
[arcticmonkey] Screw us on the tolls then give us this pitiful scrap.
Damn Kennett and the Liberals for tolls in the first place.
